name: clean-approve
description: A correct proposal: services and prices from the knowledge, the two high-impact problems addressed, the agency's terms. Measures false positives: the verdict must be approve.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: online orders without the Instagram inbox
proposal.summary: Today every order arrives as an Instagram message or a phone call, and some get lost on the way. We propose online ordering with your menu, cart and checkout, and a Google Business Profile so people in Bondi find you on Maps. You take orders while you bake.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. The website shows the menu and the hours, Instagram is active, and orders are taken by hand through direct messages and calls. There is no online ordering and no Google Business Profile, so the bakery is hard to find on Google Maps.
objectives: Take orders online, without a person answering messages
Appear on Google Maps and in local searches for bakeries in Bondi

scope.name: Online ordering
scope.description: A catalogue with your menu, a cart and a checkout, so customers order and pay without messaging you. You get each order by email and on your phone.
deliverables: Catalogue with the menu, photos and prices
Order notifications by email and on the phone

scope.name: Google Business Profile
scope.description: The listing that puts the bakery on Google Maps: hours, photos, categories and a link to order online.

scope.name: New website
scope.description: Your current site is not mobile friendly, and most customers will look you up on a phone. A new site of up to five pages, mobile first, with the menu, the hours and the map, that the ordering plugs into. Optional: the ordering works with the current site too.
deliverables: Design and up to five pages

scope.name: Monthly care
scope.description: Hosting, updates, backups and small changes to the menu, so the site keeps working without you.

out_of_scope: Changes to the current website beyond the link to the ordering, unless you take the new website

timeline.work: Menu, photos and domain access; structure of the catalogue
timeline.needs_from_client: Menu with prices, photos, access to the domain

timeline.work: Catalogue, cart, checkout and notifications; Google listing
timeline.needs_from_client: Review the preview; verify the Google listing by post or phone

timeline.work: Go live, train you on the orders screen

investment.payment_terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Two rounds of changes included.
investment.ongoing: Monthly care from AUD 80 per month, optional. Payment-provider fees are paid by you.

next_steps: Confirm the scope and the pickup options
Kickoff call to collect the menu and the photos

assumptions: Pickup only at launch; delivery is out of scope
alerts: Instagram, reviews and the competitor were not verified
questions_for_client: How many orders do you take per week today?
Who updates the menu today, and how often does it change?
